highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 brings the m151 renderer to stable together with managed perf work and newer WASM assets.
highlights_body: The release combines repeated upstream m151 syncs with targeted performance improvements in color, shaping and data paths, plus new .NET 11 WebAssembly native assets and servicing fixes discovered during the preview cycle.

bullets.lead: The stable line advanced to Skia milestone m151
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp 4.151.0 updates the bundled renderer to m151 and folds in several rounds of upstream Chrome bug fixes that shipped across the preview and release-candidate cycle.

bullets.lead: CPU raster behavior was corrected for the new engine line
bullets.detail: The release restores SK_ENABLE_LEGACY_SHADERCONTEXT to address a CPU raster regression uncovered during m151 validation.

bullets.lead: SKColor parsing gained span-friendly entry points
bullets.detail: Hex color parsing is faster and now includes ReadOnlySpan<char> overloads, making it easier to consume color values from buffers without allocating intermediate strings.

bullets.lead: GRContextOptions shed an unnecessary unsafe marker
bullets.detail: The managed API no longer requires unsafe context for GRContextOptions, simplifying consumption in codebases that avoid unsafe compilation where possible.

bullets.lead: Encoded-image subset loading no longer leaks native resources
bullets.detail: SKImage.FromEncodedData(SKData, SKRectI) now releases native allocations correctly on the subset path, preventing resource growth in repeated decode scenarios.

bullets.lead: Preview .NET WASM validation now guards the release line
bullets.detail: The release line adds the native and test support needed to catch WebAssembly exception-handling regressions early, including the new Emscripten 5.0.6 static libraries for .NET 11.

bullets.lead: Core color and text hot paths were moved onto cheaper managed code paths
bullets.detail: Several frequently used conversions and parsers now avoid per-call allocations or native round-trips, including SKColor to SKColorF conversion, SKPMColor premultiply helpers, SKShaper glyph extraction, SKFourByteTag parsing, and HarfBuzzSharp UTF-8/tag parsing.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Helped carry the 4.151 line with the WebAssembly build cleanup, the .NET 11 WASM native libraries, and cross-backend validation work during the preview cycle

preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.151 line with the Skia m151 engine update and the WebAssembly build cleanup that removed redundant WASM define noise.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added most of the managed performance work, the safer release-notes pipeline, and the first pass of new WebAssembly and raster-regression validation for the m151 line.
preview_summaries.v4.151.0-rc.1.1: The release candidate finished the line with more m151 upstream bug fixes, the .NET 11 Emscripten 5.0.6 assets, and the final validation work needed for stable release.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with faster AddUtf8 and tag parsing paths, alongside the broader text-shaping allocation work in the 4.151 release line.
